reviews.title: Perfect condition!
reviews.comment:
Arrived early & packaged well.
renewed as like new. The card posted right away, and the G force drivers installed no issues.
I can tell a huge difference in my screen graphics clarity compared to my previous card with extra fps boost. Well worth the saved money from a new one. I recommend this seller & will buy again. Thanks!!
reviews.author: Candice M.

reviews.title: Probably Good But...
reviews.comment: I bought this "two-slot" GPU for a new build but upon delivery it turned out that "two-slot" was not even close to being accurate -- this things is insanely wide, probably at least 2-1/2 slot and is a bit tall to add insult to injury. In any case there was no way it would fit my case (sorry!) which is intentionally quite compact. The case, a Shuttle Cube, will support a true two-slot GPU by the way like others I've built in the past. Attempting to return this and have gone looking for a slimmer GPU even if it is not quite a speedy.
reviews.author: J. McGaw
